title: Mechanisms of Erythropoietin-Mediated Protection Against Retinal Ganglion Cell Apoptosis.
authors: Chen, Wangling; Lao, Wei; Chen, Yunxin; Liang, Xiaoqian
journal: Medical science monitor : international medical journal of experimental and clinical research
one_liner_zh: 该文研究促红细胞生成素对视网膜神经节细胞凋亡的保护机制，涉及信号通路转录检测，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND Retinal ganglion cells (RGCs), as cells located in the innermost layer of the retina, are the last cells in the eye neural network to receive visual stimuli. This study aimed to investigate the effects of erythropoietin (EPO) on apoptosis of RGCs and clarify the mechanisms. MATERIAL AND METHODS RGCs were isolated from the mice retinas, purified with the immunopanning method, and identified by immunohistochemical assay. EPO-overexpressed lentivirus (Ov-EPO) was constructed and infected to RGCs. CCK-8 assay and TUNEL assay were used to determine RGC viability and apoptosis, respectively. RT-qPCR assay was applied to detect transcriptions of the Bcl-2, AKT1, STAT5A, and MAPK genes in RGCs treated with Ov-EPO and/or H(2)O(2)/NMDA. RESULTS Ov-EPO lentivirus was successfully established, showing higher expressing efficacy. TUNEL findings showed that EPO overexpression inhibited apoptosis of RGCs. EPO overexpression resisted oxidative damage, and excitatory toxicity caused cell death. EPO overexpression significantly increased the transcription of the AKT1 and STAT5A gene, compared with those of the blank group, suggesting activated PI3K/Akt and JAK/STAT signaling pathway in RGCs. The transcription of the MAPK gene in EPO-overexpressed RGCs was significantly increased compared with that of the RGCs of the blank group (P<0.01), suggesting that EPO overexpression is associated with the MAPK/ERK signaling pathway. CONCLUSIONS EPO played a protective role for RGC viability, and Bcl-2 played a critical role in this process. EPO inhibited apoptosis, oxidative damage, and excitatory toxicity of RGCs, which involved the potential PI3K/Akt-JAK/STAT-MAPK/ERK signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 背景 视网膜神经节细胞（RGCs）作为位于视网膜最内层的细胞，是眼神经网络中接收视觉刺激的最后细胞。本研究旨在探讨促红细胞生成素（EPO）对RGCs凋亡的影响，并阐明其机制。材料与方法 从小鼠视网膜中分离RGCs，采用免疫淘选法纯化，并通过免疫组织化学检测鉴定。构建过表达EPO的慢病毒（Ov-EPO）并感染RGCs。使用CCK-8法和TUNEL法分别测定RGCs的活力和凋亡。采用RT-qPCR检测经Ov-EPO和/或H(2)O(2)/NMDA处理的RGCs中Bcl-2、AKT1、STAT5A和MAPK基因的转录水平。结果 成功建立Ov-EPO慢病毒，显示出较高的表达效率。TUNEL结果显示，EPO过表达抑制了RGCs的凋亡。EPO过表达抵抗了氧化损伤和兴奋性毒性引起的细胞死亡。与空白组相比，EPO过表达显著增加了AKT1和STAT5A基因的转录，提示RGCs中PI3K/Akt和JAK/STAT信号通路被激活。与空白组RGCs相比，EPO过表达RGCs中MAPK基因的转录显著增加（P<0.01），表明EPO过表达与MAPK/ERK信号通路相关。结论 EPO对RGCs的活力起保护作用，Bcl-2在此过程中发挥关键作用。EPO抑制了RGCs的凋亡、氧化损伤和兴奋性毒性，这涉及潜在的PI3K/Akt-JAK/STAT-MAPK/ERK信号通路。
